items.title: 首屆亞太天主教大學運動會22日開幕！9國700名好手齊聚台灣
items.summary: 首屆「2026亞太天主教大學運動會（APCUG 2026）」明（22）日將於輔仁大學正式揭開序幕，吸引來自9個國家及地區、20所大專校院、超過700位選手齊聚台灣，展開籃球、足球及桌球三大項目競技交流。東道主輔大校長藍易振在賽前記者會上期許透過一週的賽會與文化體驗實踐天主教「共融」精神，讓各國青年建立深厚友誼，並強調「讓世界看見輔大，透過輔大看到台灣」。 《詳全文...》
items.titleEn: The first Asian Pacific Catholic University Games opened on 22nd! 700 good people from 9 countries gathered in Taiwan
items.summaryEn: The opening ceremony of the "2026 Asia Pacific Catholic University Games" (APCUG 2026) will be held at the University of Cochin on 22nd May, attracting more than 700 athletes from nine countries and regions, 20 universities and colleges to Taiwan to participate in the three major events of volleyball, football and table tennis. In a pre-race press conference, Blue Yi-Zhen, assistant principal of the university, hoped to practice the spirit of Catholic "cooperation" through a week of races and cultural experiences, to build deep friendships among young people from all over the world, and to emphasize "let the world see Taiwan through co-operation".
